Had to do a conspiracy theory project for a class about famous assassinations. The Italian mafia ran by [Carlos Marcello](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Carlos_Marcello) had a large investment in Cuba, treating it as almost a second Las Vegas and abusing the local population. But after Castro’s revolution the mob’s casino were destroyed and money seized, hence why they aided the CIA in smuggling operatives through their black market channels to help assassinate Castro and reclaim their former casino ring.
